summary: Retest after individual-account auth (username+PIN, master vs volunteer, activity audit log) replaced the shared shop-password login. Updated all pre-existing backend tests/browser checks off the old shared-password flow onto the new login model, added new artifacts for registration, role-gated /activity, attribution+before/after logging, and sign-out. 14 backend tests passed, 13 browser checks passed. No bugs found.

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_login_with_correct_credentials_succeeds
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login {username:SarahTest, pin:1234} -> 200 {authenticated:true, username:SarahTest, is_master:false}

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_master_login_reports_is_master_true
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login {username:master, pin:master2026} -> 200 {authenticated:true, is_master:true}

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_login_with_wrong_pin_rejected / test_login_with_unknown_username_rejected
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login {username:SarahTest, pin:0000} -> 401; {username:tscheck-nonexistent-user, pin:1234} -> 401

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_register_requires_correct_shop_password_and_rejects_duplicate_username
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/register with wrong shop_password -> 401; correct shop_password('oneofafind')+fresh username -> 200 {authenticated:true}; duplicate username re-register -> 409

notes: httpx's cookie jar refuses to resend the backend's Secure session cookie over this suite's plain-http localhost connection (correct prod behavior via https ingress). Worked around in backend/tests/conftest.py::login_client by pinning the Set-Cookie value as a default 'Cookie' header instead of relying on the jar. Not an app bug.
